panel.$description: Panels and sidebar. The second and last surface level.

raised.$description: Background of a default button: a control raised above canvas and panel. Not for panels or page areas.

inverse.$description: Active nav item, primary button, solid tag.

$root.$description: Fills and marks for the one thing that matters: overdue, conflict, urgent.

ink.$description: Accent as text: overdue dates, current breadcrumb.

on.$description: Text placed on a accent fill.

$root.$description: Fill for a positive state: done, saved, sent. Use sparingly; it never competes with the accent.

on.$description: Text placed on a success fill.
